Arm Wrestling

Arm Wrestling is a two-person contest. Both wrestlers press Ready in their private panels. The GM then resolves one blind Athletics check for each wrestler at the same time.

Opposed checks

Compare the two totals. A difference of 10 or more is a critical success for the higher result and a critical failure for the lower result. Any smaller positive difference is a success for the higher result and a failure for the lower result. Equal totals are a failure for both. Natural 20s and natural 1s adjust the result by one degree where applicable.

Who rolls

When a wrestler is a PC, the module requests the blind Athletics roll from an active owner of that actor and sends the result privately to the GM. NPC wrestlers are rolled automatically by the GM. The round resolves after both results are available.

Grip points

ResultGrip change
Critical SuccessGain 2 grip points
SuccessGain 1 grip point
FailureGain no grip points
Critical FailureThe opponent gains 2 grip points

Grip points cannot go below 0. The first wrestler to reach 10 grip points pins the opponent and wins the match. The GM may disqualify either wrestler at any time.

Source acknowledgement. These Arm Wrestling rules are a table rule supplied for PF2e Tavern Games.
